governed.config: kubescape runs with its own controls from the reference data volume; the project has no configuration file for it, so the project does not choose the controls

suppressions.description: not honored: kubescape takes exceptions from a separate file, which JGates does not pass

en.label: kubescape (Kubernetes security)
en.purpose: Scans Kubernetes manifests and Helm charts for security misconfigurations against the NSA, MITRE and CIS controls: privileged containers, missing limits, host access, weak defaults.
en.limitation: It reads the files only, never a cluster, and judges them by its published controls; some findings are advice for hardening rather than mistakes.
en.needs: Its control definitions, kept in the reference-data volume and refreshed with the other data (no network when it runs); about 1 GB of memory. It only applies to a project that has a Chart.yaml at its root.

pt-BR.label: kubescape (segurança Kubernetes)
pt-BR.purpose: Varre manifestos Kubernetes e charts Helm atrás de más configurações de segurança, segundo os controles NSA, MITRE e CIS: contêineres privilegiados, limites ausentes, acesso ao host, padrões fracos.
pt-BR.limitation: Lê só os arquivos, nunca um cluster, e os julga pelos controles que publica; alguns achados são recomendações de endurecimento, não erros.
pt-BR.needs: As definições dos controles, guardadas no volume de dados de referência e atualizadas com os outros dados (sem rede ao rodar); cerca de 1 GB de memória. Só se aplica a um projeto com um Chart.yaml na raiz.
